hypotheses: The judge's answer format requires each question to name the records it settles; when a question still comes back without them, iaso takes the records of the job instead of rejecting it. A question without a quote of the owner's words is usable: it reaches the owner without the "You said" line. Only a question missing its options is retried once (one using iaso's internal words reaches the agent marked to reword it, SR-362); still unusable after the retry, it goes to a debug case and its records keep waiting until the debug case fixes the question. The verdicts already given are applied.

given the judge answers like the 2026-10-16 job: three questions, each without the records it settles, when iaso reads the answer, then the three questions reach the owner through the question tool and no verdict waits

given the judge's answer format given to the model, when the judge model is asked, then the format is lenient, a question needs only its text, and the judge's instructions and iaso's retry enforce the records and 2 to 4 options (DEC-208)

given a question with one option only, when iaso reads it, then the job is retried once; if it fails again a debug case is written, the question's records keep waiting, and the other verdicts are applied
given a question with options but no quote of the owner's words, when iaso reads it, then it reaches the owner without the "You said" line and is not retried
